subagent_models.note: Aliases, not pinned ids: the Agent tool's model parameter takes sonnet, opus, haiku or fable. Measured on 2026-10-20, a prompt naming claude-opus-4-8 reached 17 of 221 archived reviewers. default goes on the pane as CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and covers a sub-agent the worker does not name; an explicit model in an Agent call beats it, verified against the real engine.

retrieval.note: A file over read_limit_bytes may not be read whole. Measured over 227 archived workers: 765 of 1,383 Read calls named no range, and the 243 of those over 8,000 tokens carried 9.09M tokens, 91% of all unbounded read volume. 32,000 bytes is about 8,000 tokens.

limit_weights.note: How the plan limits weigh each token kind is unpublished. These sets are assumptions, not facts. api-price follows the published API prices relative to base input; cache-free is our own fitted range, which put the cache-read weight at 0 to 0.05; raw counts every kind at 1 and overstates cache reads.
